note: heal-check and locate: a recorded command that matches a production class (the shipped prod-token, then the user's prod_patterns as user-prod-<n>) is prod-read when read-only and prod-write otherwise, ahead of none and local. prod-read relaunches by itself only with unattended_prod_reads allow, a consent key read from the settings file only (env is ignored with a note; a foreign CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR gets the safe value, CR-F34); prod_patterns is protective: settings file only. Heal rows carry the class id, never the command. locate prints `production: <forbid|allow> · patterns: <shipped ids> + <n> yours`. The successor session (66666666) checks the origin's lost jobs, as in HT-JV-01.

steps.name: AT-PR-01: a recorded read-only production command, every signal passes, unattended_prod_reads forbid (default): prod-read, refused, the recorded command is asked
prod-token: `product-build` is not a production token: effects none, relaunch
locate prints the production line (forbid, the shipped class only)
AT-PR-02: allow given only in the environment: forbid, with the settings-file-only note
AT-PR-02: allow in the settings file: the production read relaunches; run: is the recorded command
AT-PR-02 / CR-F34: allow under a foreign CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: the safe value (forbid), with its note; never ok

stdout_has: ^note: unattended_prod_reads: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is not ~/\.claude, safe value used$

locate counts the user's pattern, never prints it
